answer: No, you don't need a paper lien release. Texas uses electronic titles, so your lender sends the lien release to the state electronically, and there's no paper title to bring because we transfer the title electronically at your appointment. If your lender hasn't released the lien yet, ask them to do it. If you can't get them to, you can sign our lien release request, form NW-LRL-1, and we'll contact the lender for you, though this can add 1 to 2 weeks. We can still make you an offer and book your appointment while you wait.
